name: Finance PWA
postCreateCommand: ln -sf /root/.secrets/gh_token /root/.gh_token && apt-get update && apt-get install -y openssh-client python3 python3-pip python3-venv ripgrep jq unzip && mkdir -p ~/.ssh && ssh-keyscan github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts && npm install -g pnpm @anthropic-ai/claude-code && if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium; fi
